build.title: SGT Bots Rori Wiki Runtime Load

objective.summary: Complete the Rori wiki runtime load gate by proving the reviewed public wiki bundle is present in the dedicated rori schema and that the deployed SGT Bots backend can read published rows through its normal Supabase boundary.
deliverables: Verified dedicated-schema Rori wiki and directory records
out_of_scope: Changing Academy wiki content, pricing, room links, or policy facts
Changing other VPS applications or schemas
acceptance_criteria: Only rori schema records are inspected or written
The reviewed bundle remains seven published visible wiki pages, two visible rooms, and zero events
The deployed backend returns the published Rori rows through accept-profile rori
No credentials appear in tracked artifacts or evidence

requirements: Use the reviewed rori-academy-data.pbg-wiki.json bundle and the existing upsert-only generator.
Confirm migrations 008 and 009 before treating the schema as ready.
Run a deployed-backend smoke check rather than relying only on local tests.
constraints: No destructive database or VPS actions.
No subagent access to the VPS or secrets.
No user, provider, or Telegram credentials recorded in this build file.
decisions: The existing remote records are verified before any attempt to reapply the upsert bundle.
The direct PostgREST read from the deployed backend is the minimum runtime proof because it uses the same Supabase environment and rori schema header as the Rori repository.

tasks.title: Verify remote Rori schema and reviewed record counts
acceptance_criteria: Counts are seven wiki rows, seven published visible wiki rows, two room rows, two visible room rows, and zero events
evidence: Direct psql inspection on VPS2 returned rori.rori_academy_wiki_pages, rori.rori_telegram_rooms, and rori.rori_academy_events.
The same read-only query returned seven total wiki rows, seven published visible wiki rows, two total and visible room rows, and zero events.

tasks.title: Prove the deployed backend reads published Rori rows
acceptance_criteria: A process inside the deployed SGT Bots backend performs the published wiki PostgREST read with accept-profile rori
The smoke result returns HTTP 200 and the seven reviewed page keys
evidence: A Node process inside sgt-bots-app-sgt-bots-backend-1 used the deployed Supabase environment with accept-profile rori.
The deployed-backend probe received HTTP 200 and returned all seven expected published page keys.

tasks.title: Record evidence and review the Rori wiki runtime gate
acceptance_criteria: Handoff and roadmap accurately state the completed runtime check
A scoped reviewer finds no unresolved ticket or blueprint drift
evidence: Scoped review found one documentation scope issue, which was removed.
Follow-up scoped reviewer approved the corrected handoff, task list, roadmap, preflight, and error-log entries with no remaining findings.

risks: The deployed image may predate the current local branch, so the smoke test is limited to the stable Supabase retrieval contract.
Full Telegram conversation smoke testing still requires a valid playground session and is not performed by a database-only probe.

required_checks: Focused Rori import, repository, and grounding tests
results: Focused import, repository, and grounding tests previously passed: 29 tests.
Remote psql inspection returned the three rori tables and the expected seven, seven, two, two, zero record counts.
The deployed backend's direct PostgREST probe returned HTTP 200 and the seven expected published Rori page keys.
Scoped reviewer approved the corrected documentation with no remaining findings.

test_commands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/api/tests/chat/rori-academy-data-import.spec.ts apps/api/tests/chat/rori-wiki-repo.spec.ts apps/api/tests/chat/rori-kb.spec.ts --pool=forks --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1
